title: Decide a check over the whole output its receipt kept, on every path that judges a receipt
problem: Since 3d2f9cc4/af6fdfe1 a check the 16 KiB receipt prefix cannot decide is INSUFFICIENT: GREG re-observes, then asks the founder (SENSOR_FAILURE). Since f9086781/40ce615d the whole output (<= 1 MiB) is already kept in the body's content-addressed store and its address recorded on the receipt, but only `by: artifact` binds read it. So a fact past 16 KiB of fs.read, document.text or any long output costs the founder an ask, a person's refusal in a long note is never heard, and Goal Gravity distrusts the engine's own reading. Separately, one unmeasurable check beside a passing one never reached the founder at all (streak reset), and a lone surrogate past 16 KiB failed the action into a reconciliation ask.
founder_intent_refs: Founder directive 2026-10-22 sections VI (full-document capability, hostile cases 1-14) and VIII (a preview is not a result)
INTENT-20261019-UPWARD-ASCENT (recombine the artifact route with the evidence judge)
baseline: #196 190c58fb: judge() proves only monotone facts from the kept prefix; INSUFFICIENT re-observes then asks; artifact_output() reads the kept whole only for `by: artifact` binds; appraisal, preconditions, refusal watch and Goal Gravity judge the kept prefix.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: One function, judge_receipt: judge the kept output; only when INSUFFICIENT and the receipt recorded an artifact, read it through the existing artifact_output binding (address from the ledger, re-hashed, must cut to the kept output) and judge it whole. Call it from every receipt reader.
advantages: Reuses the existing store, binding and judge; no new ledger, store, authority or format.
Uncut outputs and receipts without an artifact behave exactly as before.
disadvantages: Bounded by the store's 1 MiB per output; larger outputs still ask.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: A streaming full-value predicate service: capabilities register a query interface (as document.text's phrase) and the judge asks the capability to evaluate the predicate over its full source with a coverage certificate.
advantages: No size ceiling; works for sources too large to keep.
disadvantages: Every capability needs a query contract; re-running a sensor is a new observation, not the receipt's own; much larger surface.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Repeated founder asks for outputs over 1 MiB, or a sensor whose whole output cannot be kept.

alternatives.name: raise_receipt_limit
alternatives.description: Raise RECEIPT_TEXT_LIMIT so receipts keep more.
disadvantages: Ledger growth for every long output; moves the cliff, does not remove it.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Ledger cost measured as negligible at a larger limit.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Child branch off #196 with failing-first tests and mutants; no adoption without the integrator.
disadvantages: Not exercised on a founder device.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Every long output keeps costing a founder ask; refusals in long notes stay unheard; Goal Gravity distrusts long readings; a passing check beside an unmeasurable one hides the failure forever.
disadvantages: Founder intervention on facts GREG already holds; a silent liveness hole.

roles.position: Advances section VI's full-document effect and lowers founder intervention without lowering the evidence bar. All five roles performed by one agent session (session_01KucyfnPRxLT4YY1UibJ3Ee); self-review, not independent review.
material_concerns: Outputs over 1 MiB still ask; the directive's streaming traversal remains open.

roles.position: One judge entry for every receipt reader; the artifact binding is the existing one; no new authority, store or ledger record shape.
material_concerns: Five call sites must stay consistent; a mutant per site guards it.

roles.position: A deleted, altered, non-JSON or foreign artifact, a missing store, a refused store and an output claiming its own artifact record all stay INSUFFICIENT; the appraiser refutes a closure whose artifact was altered.
material_concerns: The store and ledger share a host: whoever controls the host can rewrite both. Same trust boundary as the ledger itself.

roles.position: Reads at most one 1 MiB JSON per undecided check; nothing written changes. A failing store degrades to the old ask.
material_concerns: Store retention: an artifact pruned later makes old receipts undecidable again (honestly).

roles.position: A person's refusal past 16 KiB is now honored instead of left unheard; no check passes on a prefix.
material_concerns: Canonical Unicode equivalence is not applied (NFD text vs NFC phrase): exact code points, as before; recorded, not changed here.

evidence.claim: A required phrase past 16 KiB closes ACHIEVED with 0 founder asks and the separate appraiser returns VERIFIED
evidence.finding: Fails with the whole-output read removed (mutant 1): the ask returns.

evidence.claim: Over a kept whole, verdicts equal the verdicts on the value uncut

counterevidence.claim: INSUFFICIENT should always reach the founder
counterevidence.finding: That rule protected against judging a prefix as the whole; the kept whole is not a prefix, and its binding to the receipt is checked.
Escaped JSON can exceed 1 MiB from a 200 KiB file; those still ask (tested).

pass_1.intended_outcome: A check is decided over the whole observation its receipt kept, by every reader, and never over a prefix or an unbound artifact.

advantages.statement: Fewer founder asks for facts GREG already holds.
advantages.amplified_value: Lower founder intervention per verified outcome (the Spider-Web transaction).

advantages.statement: Engine, appraiser and Goal Gravity read the same evidence the same way.
advantages.amplified_value: No false distrust; independent re-derivation stays possible.

disadvantages.statement: Size ceiling of 1 MiB per kept output.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Above it the old ask stands, tested; streaming is the named next step.

disadvantages.statement: A forged or swapped artifact could decide a check.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Read only by the ledger's address, re-hashed, must cut to the kept output; every failure stays INSUFFICIENT.

disadvantages.statement: Changing which checks pass may change mission behaviour broadly.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Only INSUFFICIENT verdicts change; uncut outputs are untouched; neighbouring suites rerun.

comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Capability query contracts with coverage certificates.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Child branch, intake by the integrator.

rejected_alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Not needed below 1 MiB; larger surface and a new observation instead of the receipt's own.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Asks for outputs over 1 MiB recur.

rejected_alternatives.name: raise_receipt_limit
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Moves the cliff and grows the ledger.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack: deleted, altered, non-JSON, foreign and self-declared artifacts; missing and refused store; declared-incomplete outputs read whole; lists at the item limit; lone surrogates; a passing check beside an unmeasurable one; restart with an earlier incomplete reading; every reader of a receipt.

new_weaknesses.statement: Artifacts can be pruned or lost, turning a decided reading undecidable at appraisal.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Then the appraiser refuses VERIFIED (tested with an altered artifact); nothing passes on less evidence.

new_weaknesses.statement: A reader could take 'decided over the whole output' as broader than the receipt.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: The detail names the address and byte count; it is the receipt's own observation.

new_weaknesses.statement: The streak fix changes when SENSOR_FAILURE fires in mixed missions.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Single-check and all-error missions count exactly as before; only other checks' readings are skipped.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Bounded and tested; above 1 MiB the existing ask stands.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Founder asks for outputs over 1 MiB.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Six damage cases and a self-declared record stay INSUFFICIENT; appraiser refutes on alteration; mutant caught.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any change to artifact_output or output_store.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Neighbouring suites rerun; the integrator decides intake.

pass_2.final_design: judge_receipt in greg/missions.py, used by the sensor, refusal watch, appraiser re-derivation and preconditions, and Goal Gravity; ActionOutcome carries the receipt's output_artifact; one list-limit constant; surrogate-safe receipt digests; per-check sensor-failure streak.

residual_risks.risk: Outputs over 1 MiB, and sources too large to keep, still ask.
residual_risks.mitigation: Honest ask; streaming traversal with coverage certificates is the next step.

residual_risks.risk: Canonical Unicode equivalence is not applied (pre-existing).
residual_risks.mitigation: Recorded; a forbidden phrase in another normalization form can evade not_contains on any value.
residual_risks.review_trigger: A mission that checks for forbidden text in user-supplied documents.

entries.position: Section VI's streaming traversal for sources over 1 MiB is not built here.
entries.rationale: This closes the kept-output case only.
entries.evidence_threshold: A mission that must decide a fact in a source over 1 MiB.

entries.position: not_contains should match canonically equivalent text.
entries.rationale: A forbidden phrase in NFD evades an NFC check, on any value, before and after this change.
entries.evidence_threshold: Founder or integrator decision on normalization semantics.

migration_plan: None: no stored format changes. Receipts written before are read as before; a receipt without output_artifact is judged on its kept output.

steps: Revert the child branch commit(s); keep tests and records as evidence.

kill_criteria: Any check passes on a prefix or on an artifact not bound to its receipt.
The appraiser verifies a closure whose artifact was altered.
Any verdict on an uncut output changes.
decision_owner: #196 integrator (session_01FBS4KNJR59nSbdGbxo8Mbx) for intake; Alfonso for any merge
review_trigger: Integrator intake review, or a founder ask for an output over 1 MiB.
